_config: config/kaggle_tt7_decoy_b.yaml with --set segment.max_segment_duration_sec=1.0 --set vlm.enabled=true --set vlm.backend=GEMINI --set vlm.model_name=gemini-3.1-flash-lite
_why: This is the run where the state-contradiction rule fired on nothing, and it
is here because of what tests/fixtures/tt7_b_seg1_observations.json left out.
That fixture recorded the observation TEXT verbatim and the tests built their
events with object_track_id=6 throughout, which was an assumption. 21 tests
passed and production corrected zero events.
The bindings are the thing that mattered. This run's own events.json shows
the GRASP at 0.00s bound track 3 (push chopper) -- and that event's text
holds the run's ONLY state word, 'an open cardboard box'. Seeded against the
event's own object, the box's openness was recorded against the chopper, so
the three OPEN events on track 6 had nothing to contradict.
So object_track_id is recorded per observation below, read off events.json,
and no test here may substitute its own binding.
Scored: 2 EXACT, 2 REVERSED, 3 OTHER; 7/7 WITHIN_TOL; 3/7 PRECISE.
Ground truth for the disputed stretch is FOLD 2.0-3.0 then CLOSE 3.0-4.0.

verbatim: segment_start_sec / segment_end_sec, raw_action, objects, state_change and
visible_facts are copied character for character from the printed
action, object_track_id and object_label are copied from the printed
events.json dump of the same run.
absent: actor, active_hand, inference, uncertainty, confidence and the id fields
were not read back off the Kaggle box and are NOT reproduced here.
Nothing in this fixture may depend on them.
